cards.name: Boneyard Wurm
cards.oracle_text: Boneyard Wurm's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Desecrator Hag
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return to your hand the creature card in your graveyard with the greatest power. If two or more cards are tied for greatest power, you choose one of them.

rulings.comment: If the creature card has “*” in its power or toughness, the ability that defines “*” works in all zones.
This ability doesn’t target a card. It will determine which card is returned to your hand as it resolves. If there’s a tie, you choose which of the tied cards to return to your hand at that time.
The ability that defines Boneyard Wurm’s power and toughness works in all zones, not just the battlefield. If Boneyard Wurm is in your graveyard, it will count itself.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
